detail: effect = answers, not polls. Demand-driven: the driver polls the book every ~60 s but an answer only exists when a citizen files a consult, so the declared period is 3600 s (one answer per active hour expected) with 2x grace on top. A filed-but-unanswered consult aging past the driver's own poll cycle is the sharper alarm and is read directly from the book by anyone auditing; this beat proves the seat path end-to-end when answers flow.
